% _mesh_icon.tex, generated by gen_logo_tikz.py.

\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{xcolor}

\definecolor{miblue}{RGB}{31,78,121}
\definecolor{miteal}{RGB}{46,196,182}

\begin{document}

  % --- wordmark ---
  \node[anchor=base west, inner sep=0pt] at (3.05,1.28)
    {\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{34}{34}\selectfont
      \textcolor{mitext}{meshio}\textcolor{miteal}{++}};
  \node[anchor=base west, inner sep=0pt] at (3.12,0.62)
